trigger.condition: Sleep reads Plan.Config.Duration and its value is null before type validation.

likelyCauses.text: The effective Sleep Plan lacks a non-null Duration value.

diagnostics.action: Confirm ConductionCondenser and Sleep with the exact log; inspect only whether Config.Duration is present and non-null in the effective Plan.
diagnostics.expected: Presence/type/finite/sign metadata distinguishes the cited Sleep guard without exposing Plan contents.

correction.boundary: Operator proposal for the originating Sleep Plan only; do not execute a delay or alter runtime validation here.

steps.action: Supply the intended finite, nonnegative numeric Duration in seconds at the originating Plan mapping; zero is allowed, and no value should be invented.
steps.expected: The intended local Duration field satisfies the cited guard without changing other Plan fields.

stopWhen: The intended delay is unknown, source identity changed, or the observed error differs.

verification.action: Confirm Config.Duration is non-null and separately satisfies the numeric/finite/nonnegative guard before any authorized execution.
verification.expected: The cited failure guard is false for the intended Plan; actual timing remains unverified.

entries.redaction: Exclude full Plan/Config, signal payloads, credentials and downstream ST results; retain only adapter/activity, exact log and Duration presence/type/finite/sign flags.
limitations: Source-only confidence; no Sleep/runtime/provider execution was performed.
